item.title: Production Desk 1.5.9
item.description:
Production Desk 1.5.9

  • Open the offline The Last Cue demo from the sidebar, with a guide to the script breakdown, schedule, shots and lined script. Scene 1 and shots 1A–1D match the Scenic rehearsal demo.
  • The sample includes one story scene, two schedule banners, four camera setups, two planning scenarios, a two-page original PDF and six editable lining marks. Portable Production Desk files keep the original PDF and annotations.
  • Load Demo reopens your edited sample without duplicates. Reset changes only the managed demo; existing productions, legacy samples and imported copies are preserved, and Undo restores demo edits.
  • Keep the full app title readable in narrow and wide desktop windows, including Windows scrollbars while retaining the 44px new-production target, production selector and save controls.
  • A tidier sidebar places the software credit and live save status beneath the app/platform label. Production selection moves up, and the new-production plus retains a generous accessible target.
  • Existing project files, desktop updater consent/save safeguards, CSV/USS exports and original-PDF workflows remain available.
